# Pre-processing of ITP Table

## #1 Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
```

## #2 Import Data

```{r}
ITP_C2015 <- as.data.frame(read_excel(here("data","raw","ITP_C2015_Lifespan.xlsx"), guess_max=21474836))

ITP_C2016 <- as.data.frame(read_excel(here("data","raw","ITP_C2016_Lifespan.xlsx"), guess_max=21474836))

ITP_C2017 <- as.data.frame(read_excel(here("data","raw","ITP_C2017_Lifespan.xlsx"), guess_max=21474836))

sample_ids <- read.csv(here("results","table_zenodo_mpd_id.csv"), fileEncoding="latin1")
```

## #3 Join Tables

```{r}
itp_table <- rbind(ITP_C2015, ITP_C2016, ITP_C2017)
```

## #4 Add flag_censura Column

```{r}
for (row in 1:nrow(itp_table)) {
  if (itp_table$status[row] == "dead") {
    itp_table$flag_censura[row]=1
  } else {
    itp_table$flag_censura[row]=0
  }
}
```

## #5 Remove Unnecessary Columns

```{r}
itp_table$population = NULL
itp_table$dose = NULL
itp_table$age_initiation = NULL
itp_table$dead = NULL
itp_table$status = NULL
```

## #5 Change Compound Names

```{r}
interventions=intersect(sample_ids$mpd_id, itp_table$group)

for (row in 1:nrow(itp_table)) {
  if (itp_table$group[row] %in% interventions) {
    itp_table$group[row]=
      sample_ids$id[sample_ids$mpd_id==itp_table$group[row]]
  }
}
```

## #6 Remove Rapamycin (Not Continuous) Rows

```{r}
itp_table <- itp_table[!(itp_table$group %in% c("rapa_hi_cycle", "rapa_hi_start_stop")), ]
```

## #7 Export File

```{r}
write.csv(itp_table, here("results","table_ITP_Lifespan_Data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
